One sand battery is now heating a Finnish town, but a liquid metal battery ran out of money after 15 years, and another company killed its own battery to save itself. I scored each one on the Technology Readiness Level scale, from an idea on a whiteboard to something customers already use. So are these breakthroughs actually reaching customers? Or is the road from lab to market just too long?
